authorization: The J16 Owner instruction authorizes analysis and post-processing of archived data and bounded diagnostics. This step evaluates only archived matrices, right-hand sides, and solution vectors; it does not assemble a model, call a solver, modify the historical guard, or change any run status.

prior_attempt.failure: Result serialization requested interpretation_limit, which contract 001 had not declared.

inputs.verification: Check each archived JSON/NPZ artifact path, byte size, and SHA-256 against artifact_manifest.json before reading any solution data.
inputs.matrix: The exact float64 real and imaginary reduced impedance matrices saved by guard-resolution experiment 001.
inputs.right_hand_side: The exact float64 real and imaginary right-hand-side arrays saved with each matrix.
inputs.source_run_status: J15 remains PYTEST_FAILED; all 152 QF route points remain QF_GUARD_REJECTED.

method.arithmetic: Convert each archived binary64 scalar to its exact integer ratio, then evaluate complex matrix-vector product, residual, L2 relative residual, and infinity-norm backward error with mpmath.
method.comparison: Compare the high-precision residual of each represented binary64 solution to the existing guard's float64 conservative upper bound and to the previous same-matrix scaling/refinement experiment.
method.interpretation_limit: This evaluates how accurately a stored vector solves the stored binary64 assembled matrix problem. It cannot verify QF element assembly, the mechanical model, or errors in the physical problem; it does not replace a QF route decision.
method.acceptance_policy: This is post-processing, not a QF route acceptance; the unchanged 1e-7 production threshold and all historical statuses remain untouched.

completion_checks: All 11 upstream manifest artifacts pass SHA-256 and byte-size checks.
All 5 archived frequencies and all 3 archived solution variants receive high-precision metrics.
The 80- and 120-digit relative residuals agree within the stated relative-difference bound.
The output includes the interpretation limit, observed time and sampled RSS, and unchanged-status statement.

status_policy: The J16 guard-resolution attempt and J15 historical FAIL statuses are not modified. High-precision residual calculation can characterize the archived matrix solve only, not verify QF assembly or the plate mechanics.
